name: Lamb Curry with Peas
ingredients: As needed - Chopped fresh cilantro, to garnish
instructions: Coat chopped, lean, boneless lamb meat in mixture of coriander, cumin, salt and peppers and let sit for a half-hour or so. Heat oil on medium heat in a wok or deep frypan, add mustard seeds and cover. Add thinly sliced onion, minced fresh ginger and garam masala to the hot oil and stir until the onion is limp.
Push to the sides and add the lamb. Cook and stir for a few minutes until the lamb is nice and brown. Stir in water and bring to bubbling.
Cover and reduce the heat and let it simmer for nearly an hour, or until the lamb is tender. Add frozen peas and heat through, letting the sauce boil off a bit if it seems too runny.
Garnish with fresh cilantro before serving over fragrant basmati rice. Serves 4.

additional_context.source: Adapted from Jude's Kitchen and recommended by a family friend.
